name: HyenaDNA
summary: Long-range genomic foundation model, pretrained at single-nucleotide resolution on context lengths up to 1 million tokens.
description:
HyenaDNA is a long-range genomic foundation model from the Hazy Research lab at Stanford, pretrained at single-nucleotide resolution on context lengths of up to 1 million tokens, substantially longer than prior genomic language models. It is released as a family of checkpoints (tiny/small/medium/large) at varying sequence lengths.

**Licence note**: the weights are licensed BSD-3-Clause, as declared in the Hugging Face model card metadata (`LongSafari/hyenadna-large-1m-seqlen-hf`, checked 2026-09-30). The training and inference code in `github.com/HazyResearch/hyena-dna` is separately licensed Apache-2.0.

**Registry note on `model_card_uri`**: this points to the model's standard Hugging Face model card, not a GA4GH Genomic AI Model Card v0.6.0-formatted document. No model has yet published a card in the GA4GH v0.6.0 format, since it is a newly drafted specification.
